chapter.heading: The Eternal Reign of the Lord
chapter.v:
The Lord
reigns, He is clothed with majesty;The Lord is clothed,He has girded Himself with strength.Surely the world is established, so that it cannot be moved. [Dan. 5:30 d Job 12:21; Is. 45:5] [Is. 44:28 b Ps. 73:23; Is. 41:13]

Your throne
is established from of old;You are from everlasting. [Is. 40:4 f Ps.]

The floods
have lifted up, O Lord,The floods have lifted up their voice;The floods lift up their waves. [Is. 41:23 h Ex.]

The Lord
on high is mightierThan the noise of many waters,Than the mighty waves of the sea. [Is. 44:1]

Your testimonies
are very sure;Holiness adorns Your house,O Lord, forever. [Deut. 4:35; 32:39; Is. 44:8] [Is. 45:14, 18 l Ps.]
